finding: 0 quarters with row count != API total

handling in pipeline: assert in panel build (pipeline fails if > 0)

finding: fields not collected in early years: OTHBFHLB, P3ASSET
handling in pipeline: never imputed with future info: missing-indicator + training-block median; columns empty in a training block are dropped for that block

finding: negative values in fields that cannot be negative
handling in pipeline: set to null (treated as a reporting error)

finding: ratios far outside economic range (tiny denominators)
handling in pipeline: ratios recomputed from amounts with safe division; winsorised at train-period 0.5/99.5 pct

finding: risk-based capital ratios are 0 instead of null (pre-1990, and CBLR banks from 2020)
handling in pipeline: capital ratios not used as model features; equity/assets (eq_ta), which exists in all eras, is used instead
kept: genuine (and highly informative) signal, not an error

finding: small share of rows break balance-sheet identities
handling in pipeline: rows kept: DEP > ASSET coincides with negative equity (insolvency), the rest is <0.05% of rows; ratios use safe division and winsorising

finding: income items are cumulative within the calendar year
handling in pipeline: de-cumulated: flow_q = YTD_q - YTD_{q-1} (same year, consecutive quarter), Q1 = YTD; annualised x4; null when previous quarter missing

finding: missing quarters inside a bank's reporting history
handling in pipeline: lags/changes computed on the quarter index, not on row order; null when gap

finding: in-scope failure events whose CERT never appears in Financials
handling in pipeline: cannot be labelled; reported as a (tiny) coverage limitation

finding: failed institution keeps filing after FAILDATE (1989 RTC conservatorships)
handling in pipeline: rows with REPDTE >= FAILDATE are dropped; label uses the first FAILURE date

finding: assistance followed by failure, or two failures
handling in pipeline: first RESTYPE = FAILURE event defines the label; assistance is not a failure

finding: banks that stop reporting: failure vs. merger/other
handling in pipeline: failure iff CERT in Failures with RESTYPE=FAILURE; other exits keep label 0 and leave the panel after their last report

finding: CERTs in Financials missing from Institutions
Institutions holds current, not historical, BKCLASS/STNAME/SPECGRP
column dtypes differ between quarter files
